description: This file defines an EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams class that extends a base FilterParams class, used for filtering and sorting employee skill data in the OrangeHRM system. It contains properties and methods to manage an employee number filter and allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for specifying filter parameters when searching for employee skills, including employee number and sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params, setting the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
